comparable.meaning: At least two committed reports share the required identity fields and can be compared by the regression command.
comparable.next_action: Run the emitted regression command or inspect the latest and baseline receipts.
comparable.why: Same evidence family, artifact kind, model, tokenizer authority, backend, and fallback=false identity are present for the group.

failed.meaning: The committed receipt shape violates the M4 evidence contract for this operator view.
failed.next_action: Do not use the group for claims; fix or replace the bad receipt and rerun receipts-check.
failed.why: Examples include malformed receipts, artifact-kind mismatch, fallback ambiguity, or non-CPU/NEON evidence in a strict M4 group.

insufficient_history.meaning: The group has fewer than two matching-history reports, so trend or regression interpretation is not available yet.
insufficient_history.next_action: Collect a second matching report before interpreting drift.
insufficient_history.why: A latest report exists without a matching baseline under the required identity, or the report family is empty.

warning.meaning: Evidence exists, but the dashboard cannot treat the group as cleanly comparable without operator review.
warning.next_action: Inspect the emitted latest report, repair the receipt or rerun the matching evidence lane.
warning.why: The group has missing identity or metric fields, parse issues, or an incomplete report family.
